patch_description: Key parameters in the current program: the Kalman/RTS process noise (qa, clamped to [0.05, 0.6]·σ_r), the Q/4 refinement pass, and the adaptive bidirectional one-pole alpha. The main weakness is that the RTS smoother's velocity state is discarded. The new algorithm keeps the full Kalman/RTS machinery but (1) reduces the process-noise floor so the smoother trusts the constant-velocity model more (lower noise on quiet segments → fewer false reversals), (2) exploits the smoothed velocity state: after smoothing, a velocity-limited reconstruction clamps per-step displacement of the output to 2·|xs[:,1]| + 0.5·σ_r, which directly suppresses spurious slope changes and noise-induced reversals while provably preserving genuine trend segments (which have large |velocity|), and (3) uses a stronger adaptive zero-phase one-pole pass (alpha range 0.45–0.9) to further reduce residual ripple without adding phase lag. Output contract unchanged.
